what: The gold foil (reflected repeating linear gradient) and round gloss on an SVG sticker/badge slide to follow the cursor position — using the cursor ratio inside the element (−.5~1.5), the foil start/end points are pushed in the opposite direction by image size × .9 and the gloss center is placed toward the cursor. Each frame it follows .08 of the remaining difference, and with no mouse (touch) it drifts on its own on sine cycles of 1.6s and 2.1s. Pauses when off-screen

options.travel: Distance the gold foil is pushed (multiple of picture size), default .9
options.[data-fx-part=foil]: SVG linearGradient(gradientUnits=userSpaceOnUse, spreadMethod=reflect) — changes x1 · y1 · x2 · y2
options.[data-fx-part=shine]: SVG radialGradient (userSpaceOnUse) — changes cx and cy. If neither exists, it does nothing

from.where: shared.js all holo stickers — original Holo script (cursor ratio −.5~1.5, ×.9, lerp .08, without a mouse sin(t/1600)·cos(t/2100) × .6)
